state.name: Create New Tag — Open
state.purpose: Create a new tag while selecting tags for a task.

form.helperText: Use a short name that helps you find this tag later.

visualRules: Use the global bottomSheet pattern from design-system.json.
Use the existing global text-input and primary-button patterns.
Use Material Symbols Rounded for Back and Close.
Do not allow users to choose an icon for a tag.
Tag identity is represented by its text label.
Do not introduce a tag color selector.
Create tag is the only primary action.
Back returns to the Tag Selector without closing the entire tag flow.
Close dismisses the entire tag flow.
Do not introduce screen-specific colors, spacing or radii.

reference.description: Approved Create New Tag bottom-sheet state opened from the task Tag Selector.
